title: Job Openings at S-TEE Schools
content:
S-TEE has maintained a strong commitment to imparting sound moral, academic, spiritual and life training skills into our learners. We believe that if our processes (tutoring, teaching, modelling, coaching, training, counselling, etc) are well structured and implemented, we will produce great minds, expert thinkers, solution-driven personnel, who will take the world by storm.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Mathematics Teacher

Job Location: Lagos

Responsibilities
The job functions include but not limited to the following:
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Responsible for developing in each student an interest in and the ability to understand and utilize their knowledge of in Computer Studies.
	with minimun of 5 years IGCSE teaching experience.
	To oversee the provision of relevant and up to date advice and support for pupils as it relates to the subject.
	To co-ordinate the selection and development of appropriate syllabus and courses in line with related resources.
	To maintain full and accurate records of students’ achievements as it relates to the subject.
	Deliver engaging, coherent and motivating lessons to students across in varying classes.
	Utilize learning technology in the planning and delivery of lessons.
	To keep up to date with curriculum change and reforms.
	Develop lesson plans in line with the curriculum objectives.
	To plan for, provide and maintain the physical resources necessary for learning and the delivery of chosen syllabuses and courses (including for example; books, past papers, file shares, furniture, equipment etc). Where necessary, liaise with other department to achieve this feat.
	To undertake, where appropriate, other roles, which may arise either in the department or in the wider school environment.
	Any other duties relating to the job as required from time to time by the Head of School /Principal.


Requirements


	The preferred candidate must have a minimum of a (B. Ed) or (B.Sc.) with a PGD. 
	Must have a minimum of 3 years of teaching experience.
	Must possess strong practical knowledge and skills in delivering lessons to students
	Must possess strong interpersonal skills.
	Be enthusiastic and passionate about teaching and be able to demonstrate a genuine care for young children.
	Ability to utilize technology in the teaching and learning process.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Inventory Supervisor",
  "description": "Fadac Resources and Services Limited - We are a professional consulting/recruitment company dedicated to connecting businesses with qualified, skilled, and reliable talent. We provide end-to-end recruitment solutions, from candidate sourcing and screening to interviews and placement, helping organizations build strong teams while providing job seekers with suitable career opportunities.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Inventory Supervisor

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	To ensure accurate control, safe storage and timely issue of raw materials, packaging materials and finished goods, so that production is never interrupted and inventory records match physical stock at all times.


Key Responsibilities
Receiving and Storage:


	Supervise the receipt, offloading and checking of raw materials, packaging materials and finished goods against purchase orders and delivery documents.
	Coordinate with Quality on inspection and approval of incoming materials before they are put into stock.
	Ensure that materials are stored correctly by category and condition (dry, ambient or temperature-controlled) and kept clear of walls, floors and pests.
	Maintain a clear, labelled and well-organised warehouse layout.


Stock Control:


	Enforce FEFO / FIFO in the storage and issue of all items.
	Ensure that every stock movement (receipt, issue, transfer, return) is recorded in the ERP or inventory system on the same day.
	Issue materials to production against approved requisitions and keep supporting documents.
	Monitor minimum, maximum and reorder levels and alert Procurement and Planning early to prevent stock-outs and overstocking.


Stock Counts and Reconciliation:


	Plan and conduct regular cycle counts and full stock takes.
	Reconcile physical stock against system records, investigate variances and report findings with recommended actions.
	Work with Finance and Internal Audit on stock valuation and audit requests.
	Expiry, Damage and Wastage Control
	Track near-expiry, slow-moving, obsolete, damaged and quarantined stock, and report it to management in good time.
	Ensure that rejected and expired materials are separated, recorded and disposed of with proper approval.


Dispatch and Coordination:


	Coordinate the preparation, loading and dispatch of finished goods, and verify quantities and documentation.
	Work with Production, Procurement, Quality and Sales on material availability and delivery schedules.


Team Supervision:


	Allocate duties to store keepers and warehouse staff and supervise their daily work.
	Train the team on stock handling, documentation, safety and system use.
	Report attendance and performance issues to the Warehouse / Supply Chain Manager.


Health, Safety and Reporting:


	Enforce safe handling, correct use of forklifts and PPE, and housekeeping standards.
	Prepare daily, weekly and monthly inventory reports, including stock status, ageing and variances.


Requirements


	B.Sc or HND in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Accounting, Logistics or a related field.
	3&ndash;5 years of experience in inventory or warehouse management in an FMCG or manufacturing environment, including at least 1 year in a supervisory role.
	Hands-on experience with an ERP or inventory management system.
	Knowledge of FEFO / FIFO and warehouse best practice.


Skills and Competencies


	Strong numeracy, accuracy and attention to detail
	Good Excel skills for stock analysis and reporting
	Organisational and time management skills
	Integrity and strong internal control discipline
	Leadership and team supervision
	Clear communication across production, finance and procurement


Working Conditions:


	Based at the Haano Industry plant in Lagos; work is carried out in a factory and warehouse environment.
	May be required to work extended hours, shifts or weekends depending on production needs.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: oluwaseun.f@fadacresources.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",
